paths.description: Entry page and gallery directory; represents global navigation, discovery, theme, network, security, performance and directory density.
League of Legends gallery listing; represents high-density board/list template and route navigation.
Public article detail with comments; represents content/thread template and no-JS content.
Public gallery composer; represents primary authoring form and empty-submit recovery without publishing content.

findings.summary: System dark preference does not automatically produce a dark surface.
findings.evidence: The prefers-color-scheme: dark screenshot remains the same white desktop canvas as the default capture, while the page exposes a separate manual night-mode control.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and drive surface/text tokens from prefers-color-scheme or light-dark(), while retaining an explicit user override.

findings.summary: Motion continues under reduced-motion preference.
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion evaluate probe reports a running gradient2 animation with a 250 ms duration while matchMedia(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) is true.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce rule that removes non-essential animation and auto-advance.

findings.summary: State changes use abrupt legacy swaps rather than view transitions.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection across home, listing and detail found no view-transition CSS; navigation and carousel state are instant in the captured surfaces.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document or cross-document View Transitions for meaningful gallery/list/detail and carousel state changes, with reduced-motion fallback.

findings.summary: Long pages provide little position-aware navigation.
findings.evidence: The mobile listing/detail captures render desktop-width, very long pages with static header chrome; DOM/CSS inspection found no scroll-state query or progress indicator.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact sticky header and scroll-state/progress affordance that preserves context on long lists and threads.

findings.summary: Dense chrome and tiny repeated controls compete with core content.
findings.evidence: Desktop and mobile screenshots show dense boxed navigation, rankings, side modules, and hundreds of small links; the home probe counted 3,257 interactive elements, 907 under 24 px in one dimension.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the current gallery/content, collapse secondary directories, reduce repeated borders, and use a comfortable type scale and spacing.

findings.summary: The desktop site is not usable as a true narrow layout.
findings.evidence: At a requested 360x800 viewport there is no viewport meta. Home renders a 1,101 CSS-pixel layout at scale 0.327; listing/detail render 1,440 CSS pixels at scale 0.25 and report 75 px horizontal overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a standards viewport meta tag and rebuild templates with fluid/intrinsic layouts; serve equivalent responsive content rather than shrinking a fixed desktop canvas.

findings.summary: Touch targets are extensively undersized.
findings.evidence: The home probe counted 907 of 3,257 interactive elements below 24 px in at least one dimension; listing/detail probes counted 227/501 and 271/614 respectively. Lighthouse also failed target-size.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a minimum 44x44 CSS-pixel hit area for primary touch controls, increase spacing, and preserve visible :focus-visible styles.

findings.summary: Empty composer submission provides no clear, accessible recovery state.
findings.evidence: After activating Register with an empty composer, the evaluate probe found no :invalid controls, no role=alert/error text, and focus remained on an anonymous DIV; the screenshot was visually unchanged.
findings.suggestedFix: Use required constraints, validate after interaction, focus the first invalid field, set aria-invalid, and announce a concise error summary in a live region.

findings.summary: Initial content is slow to become visible.
findings.evidence: The raw-CDP trace recorded FCP/LCP at 5.254 s and loadEventEnd at 7.043 s; Lighthouse corroboration reported a poor performance score and an even slower mobile-path LCP.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP content, reduce blocking styles/scripts, and defer non-critical advertising and analytics.

findings.summary: Critical delivery is burdened by large uncompressed blocking resources.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 85 requests and 2.94 MB transferred, including 907 KB CSS and 1.65 MB JS. Eight parser-inserted stylesheets were VeryHigh priority and multiple 100-401 KB CSS/JS files lacked content encoding.
findings.suggestedFix: Compress text, consolidate/trim critical CSS, defer non-critical styles and scripts, and set useful cache headers.

findings.summary: Large amounts of unused JavaScript and CSS ship on load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 425 KiB unused JavaScript and 375 KiB unused CSS; HAR shows 37 scripts and eight stylesheets.
findings.suggestedFix: Use coverage to split templates, load gallery/editor/advertising code only when needed, and remove duplicate legacy bundles.

findings.summary: Core controls and composer fields lack accessible names or labels.
findings.evidence: axe found critical button-name/label/link-name failures on home and, on the composer, an unnamed role=textbox editor, unnamed image/link, and multiple unlabeled inputs.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every control a programmatic and visible name, associate labels, name the rich-text textbox, and make decorative images presentational.

findings.summary: Text contrast fails WCAG AA.
findings.evidence: axe reported 1.93:1 white-on-green text and 3.9:1 ranking badges on home, plus 2.84:1 composer placeholder text; Lighthouse reported 42 low-contrast nodes.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background tokens to at least 4.5:1 for normal text and retest both themes.

findings.summary: Heading, landmark, and skip-link structure is unreliable.
findings.evidence: The DOM has an empty H1 and many empty headings; axe reports invalid heading order, content outside landmarks, and skip links whose targets do not exist.
findings.suggestedFix: Use one meaningful H1, a logical heading hierarchy, contain content in landmarks, and ensure each skip target exists and can receive focus.

findings.summary: Text becomes illegibly small on narrow screens.
findings.evidence: The 360x800 screenshots shrink fixed desktop layouts to 25-33% scale, making labels, metadata, and controls unreadable without zoom.
findings.suggestedFix: Use responsive type and line-height tokens, reflow columns, and avoid scale-to-fit desktop rendering.

findings.summary: Image/document asset hygiene has defects.
findings.evidence: Images audit found all three homepage images lacked explicit dimensions; Lighthouse found two image aspect-ratio failures, while the page otherwise has a valid doctype and UTF-8 charset.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare intrinsic width/height or aspect-ratio and correct mismatched rendered dimensions.

findings.summary: Browser inspector issues and legacy patterns remain.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse inspector-issues failed, while DOM probes counted 63 javascript: links on home and 11 on the listing; these controls are fragile and not naturally crawlable/actionable.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace javascript: anchors with buttons or real href links and resolve all DevTools Issues panel diagnostics.

findings.summary: Baseline security headers are absent.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive confirms HTTPS but no CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors, strict-origin-when-cross-origin referrer policy, and a minimal Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Cookies are not protected with modern transport and SameSite defaults.
findings.evidence: The cookie audit found 20 cookies marked SameSite=None and 19 without Secure, including PHPSESSID without Secure; several analytics cookies persist 400 days.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark all HTTPS cookies Secure, use Lax/Strict by default, retain HttpOnly for session cookies, and shorten analytics retention.

findings.summary: The page has a broad tracking and third-party footprint.
findings.evidence: Tracker capture observed 17 third-party origins and five known tracker domains, including Google Analytics, Tag Manager, DoubleClick, and Google ad services; HAR transferred 2.94 MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce trackers and duplicate analytics, gate optional tracking behind meaningful consent, batch telemetry, and self-host essential assets.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policies are not configured.
findings.evidence: Headers evidence shows no clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, CSP/Trusted Types enforcement, or HSTS; page metadata also declares referrer=unsafe-url.
findings.suggestedFix: Add frame-ancestors, a privacy-preserving Referrer-Policy, minimal Permissions-Policy, HSTS and CSP/Trusted Types where feasible; remove unsafe-url.

findings.summary: The app-like community has no valid install/offline surface.
findings.evidence: The linked manifest contains only a legacy gcm_sender_id comment/config and no name, icons, start_url, display, or scope; no offline fallback was exposed.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish a valid web app manifest and service worker with an offline reading/failure fallback, or remove the misleading manifest link.

findings.summary: The Korean locale is declared, but layout CSS is dominated by physical positioning.
findings.evidence: DOM reports html lang=ko, but rendered CSS excerpts and legacy templates use extensive left/right/top pixel positioning and no container-query/logical-layout evidence.
findings.suggestedFix: Retain lang=ko and migrate reusable layout rules to inline/block logical properties so translation and writing-mode changes do not break placement.

findings.summary: Composer validation does not prevent and recover from mistakes humanely.
findings.evidence: Empty submission produced no visible error, no native invalid state, no aria-invalid, no alert, and no focus movement to a field.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply required constraints and :user-invalid styling after interaction, then announce and focus the first actionable error.

findings.summary: Input assistance is incomplete on core forms.
findings.evidence: Composer probe shows unlabeled nickname/editor fields and most text inputs have empty autocomplete; axe confirms labels are missing on several inputs.
findings.suggestedFix: Add visible labels and appropriate autocomplete/inputmode tokens, especially username/nickname and password fields.

findings.summary: Resource weight is disproportionate for a mostly text directory page.
findings.evidence: HAR transferred 2.94 MB for the home page, including 907 KB CSS and 274 KB image resources; Lighthouse found a 503 KB ad image among the largest resources.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a template-specific byte budget, serve modern/responsive images, and avoid loading heavy decorative/ad assets before they are useful.

findings.summary: Third-party scripts and analytics consume a large share of the page budget.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 37 script requests and 1.65 MB transferred as scripts; tracker evidence lists 17 third-party origins and repeated analytics/tag-manager endpoints.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer third-party work until consent or interaction, remove duplicate tags, and enforce per-vendor performance/privacy budgets.

findings.summary: Indexing infrastructure is incomplete.
findings.evidence: Canonical and robots signals are present and raw HTML is crawlable, but /sitemap.xml returns 404 on a site with roughly 96,000 galleries.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish sitemap indexes for public gallery/list/detail templates and keep them aligned with robots policy and canonical URLs.

findings.summary: Entity pages lack structured data.
findings.evidence: Open Graph/Twitter metadata is present, but the DOM probe found zero JSON-LD blocks on home and the audited article detail, despite clear Organization/WebSite and DiscussionForumPosting entities.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate schema.org JSON-LD for WebSite/Organization and discussion posts while preserving the existing social metadata.
